kjv: the forest of the vintage is come down
mine: the dense forest has been cut down
note: The ketiv habbatsur means "inaccessible, impenetrable" (a dense forest); the KJV follows the qere habbatsir ("the vintage"), which makes little sense of a forest. I preferred the ketiv.

kjv: the pride of Jordan is spoiled
mine: the thickets of the Jordan are ruined
note: Hebrew ge'on hayyarden (also Jer 12:5; 49:19) is the lush jungle along the Jordan where lions lived, not an abstract "pride".

kjv: And I (Zechariah) will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock
mine: So I (Zechariah) shepherded the flock marked for slaughter, the afflicted of the flock
note: Hebrew wa'er'eh is a past narrative form: the prophet carries out the command of 11:4; "the afflicted of the flock" stands in apposition, not as a vocative address.
Hebrew ro'i ha'elil uses 'elil in its basic sense "worthless, good-for-nothing"; the shepherd is useless, not an idol.
